title: Annotations and Label Layout
intent: Add data-driven text to marks and resolve avoidable collisions within bounded chart or Canvas space.
useWhen: Use this recipe when selected or complete observations need readable labels anchored to final mark positions.
avoidWhen: Avoid this recipe when dense labels cannot fit or when a legend communicates the categories more clearly.
prerequisites: Provide immutable row objects containing every field named by the selected actions and example program.
Use explicit public resource identifiers whenever current program state contains more than one compatible candidate.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: An array of plain row objects containing the fields required by this task.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Task-specific field names, resource identifiers, and supported visual or statistical choices.

outcomes: Add data-driven text to marks and resolve avoidable collisions within bounded chart or Canvas space.

steps.instruction: Create the data, marks, encodings, and owned resources required before authoring the annotations and label layout result.
Apply the primary action that produces the recognizable annotations and label layout result or workflow.
Add only the supporting encodings, marks, and owned resources needed for the requested annotations and label layout variant.
Use the focused lifecycle actions only after their owned annotations and label layout resources exist and are uniquely targeted.

alternatives.when: Choose a neighboring recipe when its stated result and data roles match the requested chart more directly.
alternatives.instruction: Prefer one complete domain facade or task recipe before composing lower-level actions manually.

pitfalls.problem: Implicit targeting fails when several compatible datasets, marks, scales, guides, or owners exist in the same program.
pitfalls.fix: Pass the exact public identifier named by the action signature instead of relying on first-resource selection.
